name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Projet commun
title: REPORT on the joint text on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026 approved by the Conciliation Committee under the budgetary procedure
part_text:
The European Parliament and EU governments have agreed the EU budget for 2026. Total spending is set at about 192.8 billion euros in commitments and 190.1 billion euros in payments. The deal adds money for research, transport and energy links, health, humanitarian aid and defence, and creates a new fund for Moldova. It cuts farm support slightly and reduces the running costs of the EU institutions because salaries rose less than expected. Parliament approved this joint text, so the budget is now adopted.

- The 2026 EU budget is agreed: about 192.8 billion euros for commitments, 190.1 billion for payments.
- Money goes to research, transport, energy, health, aid, defence and Moldova; farm payments fall slightly.
- Parliament approved the deal, so the budget is adopted and will be published.
